_readme: Rules for .github/workflows/seo-automerge.yml. Read from the default branch only. A pull request from a fix/seo-* or blog/* branch merges on its own when every Vercel status on its commit is green and every changed file matches allow (case-sensitive), matches no deny (any case), and the size limits hold. The workflow also has a built-in list that is never auto-merged (workflows, package files, config, env, API routes, scripts). In globs, ** matches any depth including none (components/**/*form* matches components/ContactForm.tsx). Set enabled to false to hold every pull request of that kind for a person. denyPatch: regular expressions (case-insensitive); a pull request that adds or removes a line matching one is held; an entry may be {pattern, files} to apply only to those files. linkOnly: files that may only gain internal links inside existing sentences (link markup stripped, removed lines must equal added lines). linkOnlyIgnore: regular expressions (case-sensitive) cut from each changed line of a linkOnly file before that comparison, for metadata such as meta titles and alt text; an entry may be {pattern, files}. futureDate: on new files matching files, every listed date field must be a plain YYYY-MM-DD after today in Los Angeles, so a new post can be scheduled but never go live at once. binaryOk: new image files there need no line diff.
